title: Quasilinear normal form for the Kirchhoff-Poho{\v z}aev equation
summary: On the $n$-dimensional torus $\mathbb{T}^n$, we consider the Kirchhoff-Poho{\v z}aev equation, which is the only Kirchhoff-type equation known to admit global solutions for small initial data in $H^s \times H^{s-1}$, $s \geq 2$. We study this equation from a dynamical perspective by means of a quasilinear normal form approach. We perform two steps of normal form reduction and show that the resulting cubic and quintic terms do not contribute to the Sobolev energy estimates.
